text: Harbour City’s patient build-up play in a 4-2-3-1 formation was highly effective, as demonstrated by the 17-pass sequence lasting nearly a minute before Elias Okafor’s goal, which capitalized on a well-timed through pass from Marek Barros [#904]. The controlled possession and short passing limited Seabrook Town’s wide crossing threats, allowing Harbour City to dominate possession and create a big chance through systematic midfield recycling involving Lindqvist, Valdez, and Castillo. However, maintaining such patience requires focus and precise positioning to exploit defensive gaps at the right moments. Coaching point: emphasize timing and coordinated forward runs to maximize the threat created by sustained possession.
